messages:
Ji: Flagging a weird accounting artifact seen in prod at 15:07UTC. Customer saw a short-lived 2x provisional line for one streaming request after a resume + toolcall. tagging @Lina for metering and @Harper for router.

Lina: thanks. can you share trace/session ids and a brief timeline?

Ji: trace t_334b, sess s_77a. Timeline: client opens stream -> emits 90-token prefix -> network hiccup -> client reconnects with resume_key -> router forwards to different backend instance (handoff) -> during resume a toolcall triggers (sync op) -> EOF from model -> ledger shows two provisional claims then a merge later. Customer saw temporary quota alarm.

Harper: that sounds like session affinity/guided-resume didn't carry the original provisional context. router handoff created a new resume path so ledger got duplicate provisional claims. we should check whether resume_key is being passed through the handoff metadata.

Ji: raw ledger lines (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-01T15:07:02Z] ledger: provisional claim id=pA123 trace=t_334b sess=s_77a tokens=45 hash=0x9f12
[2026-03-01T15:07:05Z] router: handoff instance=i-22 -> i-47 (region:us-west -> us-west-b)
[2026-03-01T15:07:05Z] ledger: provisional claim id=pB124 trace=t_334b sess=s_77a tokens=45 hash=0x9f12
[2026-03-01T15:07:06Z] toolcall: invoke tool_sync trace=t_334b parent_provisional=pA123
[2026-03-01T15:07:07Z] ledger: confirm pA123 -> cX500 tokens=45
[2026-03-01T15:07:08Z] ledger: confirm pB124 -> cX501 tokens=45
[2026-03-01T15:07:10Z] reconciliation: merge cX500,cX501 -> cX500 tokens=45 (refund issued)
```

Rohit: console saw both confirmed lines for ~3s then reconciliation UI showed a refund. customer got an automated quota alert during that window which is confusing. we need to reduce transient churn.

Lina: cause candidates: (a) resume_key not propagated in handoff metadata, (b) provisional claims keyed to connection object instead of resume-id, (c) toolcall created a child provisional and that was confirmed separately.

Harper: router fix would be: ensure `resume_key` and `parent_provisional` headers are forwarded on handoff. That reduces new provisional creation. downside: touching router metadata path is invasive.

Lina: metering-side approach: add a lightweight server-side coalesce step on confirm that calls an internal `confirm-merge` API. Behavior: when a confirm comes in, ledger checks for other provisional ids with same prefix hash within a grace window (e.g., 15s). If found, atomically confirm the earliest provisional and tombstone others, mark reconciled_ids=[...]. This avoids double confirmed rows downstream.

Ji: +1 for confirm-merge. We should also publish merge metadata so console can render a single row with a small badge "merged x provisional(s)" and link to trace.

Rohit: UX idea: suppress automated quota alarms while a trace remains in the provisional grace window OR add a separate "provisional spike" alert type showing reconciled_count. Not ideal to mute real surges though. Maybe only suppress if merged_count > 0 and total_confirmed tokens after reconciliation < threshold.

Lina: concurrency note: two confirms may race in different shards. confirm-merge needs linearization. Implement with a provisional-hash key in our distributed kv and use CAS to elect the canonical confirmer. Add unit tests for the race.

Harper: alternative hybrid: router change to forward `parent_provisional` plus metering confirm-merge as a safety net. That way most cases are prevented at source and the ledger handles the leftovers.

Ji: ops concern: refunds/backfill flow must not double-apply; when we tombstone provisional pB124, do NOT emit refund in billing system; instead mark refund emission suppressed with merged_reason in audit log.

Lina: agreed. We'll add `suppress_refund` flag when tombstoning in confirm-merge. Also include merged_ids in the confirmed record for tracing.

Rohit: monitoring: add panels: provisional_count_per_trace, provisional_merge_rate, transient_confirm_rows, and a histogram of time_to_reconcile. Also add an alert if merge_rate > 0.5% in a region for > 5m (indicates systemic issue).

DeployBot: Canaries scheduled: ledger/confirm-merge -> 2026-03-03T02:00Z (canary: us-west-b low-traffic). router/forward-headers patch -> 2026-03-04T03:00Z (canary: us-west).

Ji: plan: 1) PR for confirm-merge handler in ledger (Lina+Rohit review), 2) small console change to collapse provisional rows and show merged badge (Harper+UX review), 3) router patch to forward resume_key (Harper owns). Start with (1) canary, then enable console collapse for a test org, then router patch.

Lina: I'll draft unit+integration tests and a sim that replays the trace and induces a handoff to validate tombstoning and suppress_refund semantics.

Harper: I'll add a tiny header pass-through test to the router e2e and coordinate with infra for canary routing.

Ji: thanks all. Opening the tickets and PRs now. will post links here. :thumbsup:
